newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Farmers see 205 mln tns EU grain crop in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Farmers see 205 mln tns EU grain crop in 1996.

text.p: European Union farmers expect grain production in the 15 member states to rise to 205.1 million tonnes in 1996, from 175.4 million tonnes last year, they said in an estimate released on Tuesday.
The figures, presented by the EU farmers' organisation COPA to a closed-door EU cereals advisory committee meeting on Friday, was sharply higher than a July estimate of 191.3 million tonnes.
The estimate, which is subject to revision, was also four million tonnes higher than the European grain traders' association forecast on Friday.
EU sources, showing surprise that the COPA figure was so high, said farmers crop forecasts were usually pessimistic and bullish for prices.
But the latest COPA estimate was likely to have a bearish impact, they added.
COPA put the maize crop, which is still being harvested, at 35.3 million tonnes, up from 29.8 million in 1995.
Soft wheat was put at 90.5 million tonne, up from 79 million last year, while durum wheat was seen at 8.3 million tonnes, against 6.4 million.
Barley was also seen jumping to 53.2 million tonnes, from 44 million last year.
The balance was made up of rye, oats and other cereals.
